main.description: A piece of audio published by the account, such as a song, demo or set. The account is its artist.

description.description: Free-form text about the track, such as notes, credits or lyrics.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this track was originally created.

original.description: The audio file as uploaded, unchanged. Kept so the other encodings can be regenerated.

lossless.description: Lossless encoding of the original at its sample rate and bit depth, for playback. May be regenerated and replaced by the uploading app.
